title: shock, toxic waste and dry ice barrels join the red one
why: His note (2026-10-18 15:47, in a raid, build 30.73): "add other exploding barrels, e.g. electricity, toxic waste, dry ice". Three new kinds laid beside the red one on the Forge elements: SHOCK (yellow drum, black bolt, a blue spark off the lid): a smaller blast that stuns what it strikes and chains arcs on to the next bodies. ACID (green drum, black trefoil, a drip down the side): the smallest blast, eats armour and leaves a pool for six seconds that hurts and keeps eating. CRYO (ice-blue drum, snowflake, wisps of cold): a frost burst, the middle freezes and the rim is slowed, with a fog for five seconds that keeps chilling; a frozen crawler shatters in any barrel blast. No barrel was added and no draw was taken: the kind of each existing barrel is a pure hash of the raid seed and its spot (55 percent red, 15 percent each of the new three), so the seeded stream, the ents and the containers are exactly what they were (seed 4242: ents 85/374, containers 165/593) and every window of a party sees the same kinds. Each kind has its own sound built from the recordings already in the bank, lights the barrels in its reach in a chain, and never hurts a teammate (no team damage, as the red one). The stun and the cold are the own code of the gun, lifted into elemStun and elemChill.
now: Three new barrels join the red one: shock, toxic waste and dry ice. Each blast does its own thing, and a frozen crawler shatters.
